programs=work/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not grid:
        return out
    last = len(grid) - 1
    for col, value in enumerate(grid[last]):
        if value != 5:
            continue
        seeds = [(r, grid[r][col]) for r in range(len(grid)) if grid[r][col] != 0]
        prev = -1
        for r, color in seeds:
            for rr in range(prev + 1, r + 1):
                out[rr][col] = color
            prev = r
        for rr in range(prev + 1, len(grid)):
            out[rr][col] = 5
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p.read_text())
